Class FutureAndExoplanetScenarioCatalog

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.model.FutureAndExoplanetScenarioCatalog
public final class FutureAndExoplanetScenarioCatalog extends Object

FutureAndExoplanetScenarioCatalog

Canonical built-in scenario presets for Future Earth trajectories ($+2026\,\text{CE}$ to $+2150\,\text{CE}$), Solar System colonization, and Exoplanetary civilizational configurations.
Also orchestrates the unified getBuiltInScenarios() assembly and resolvePresetKey(String, String) lookup.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
